lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Mg6Sb2 (reduced formula Mg3Sb) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 8 atoms per unit cell distributed over 2 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for both Mg and Sb centers, each with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom: Mg is surrounded by 8 Mg and 4 Sb neighbors, while Sb is coordinated by 12 Mg atoms, with neighbor distances ranging from 3.184 to 3.392 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component containing all 8 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals that Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibit corner, edge, and face sharing, whereas Sb-centered polyhedra share corners and edges.
